taskTitle: Classify local OpenAI JSON-schema HTTP 400 errors precisely
taskPrompt: Fix the local OpenAI-compatible model client so that HTTP 400 responses are classified as LOCAL_JSON_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED only when the upstream error specifically indicates that response_format/json_schema support itself is unavailable. Generic invalid requests and invalid supplied schemas must remain LOCAL_REQUEST_REJECTED. json_object mode must not use the JSON-schema-unsupported classification. Add focused regression coverage using mocked globalThis.fetch with no real network. Modify only packages/integrations/src/local-openai-compatible-model-client.ts and tests/smoke/contracts.ts, respect the configured patch budget, and preserve unrelated transport classification, endpoint policy, credential handling, request construction, timeout behavior, dependencies, and RunPod client behavior.
requiredAssertions: an explicit upstream lack of response_format/json_schema support maps to LOCAL_JSON_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED
a generic HTTP 400 invalid request maps to LOCAL_REQUEST_REJECTED
an invalid supplied JSON schema maps to LOCAL_REQUEST_REJECTED
json_object mode does not classify HTTP 400 as LOCAL_JSON_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED
regression coverage uses mocked globalThis.fetch without real network
only the two authorized files change
patch stays within the configured maxPatchLines budget
source worktree and GitHub remain immutable
